content:
maria: Heads-up — customer 'delta-inc' reported small but visible token drift during a fast reconnect + toolcall sequence. Repro attached. Suspect prefetch replay + aggregator tombstone race.

dan: Can you paste the minimal trace? streaming? toolcall?
maria: Streaming with in-flight toolcall. Sequence: client sends toolcall, connection reconnects, prefetch replay begins while aggregator flushes pending chunk. Two ledger rows for same offset but one is later tombstoned by the resume path. Ledger tombstone currently doesn’t prevent billing emission. Logs:

```
[2026-03-25T16:01:10Z] session=dl-01 offset=4096 aggregator=flush tokens=28 write_id=wid-A counted=true
[2026-03-25T16:01:10Z] reconnect resume_offset=4096 prefetch=replay write_id=wid-B provisional=false
[2026-03-25T16:01:11Z] resume.confirm session=dl-01 offset=4096 tombstone_write wid-A reason=resume_overwrite
[2026-03-25T16:01:11Z] ledger.tombstone applied for wid-A but billing already emitted for wid-A
```

kevin: So tombstone happens after billing emission. We need to avoid emitting final billing until tombstone/confirm window closes or make tombstone-triggered reversals automatic. Both have pros/cons.

anya: New idea: add a reversible credit model with three states {pending, posted, reversed}. On initial write we mark as pending; billing pipeline only counts posted. Tombstone causes transition pending->reversed (no billing). Confirm flips pending->posted. That way we can handle overwrite/tombstone races without retro refunds.

maria: That’s similar to provisional but adds explicit reverse action rather than an expire-confirm TTL. It also gives us a clear audit trail of reversals caused by tombstones.

dan: Implementation outline:
- ledger API: write(session,offset,write_id,meta) creates an entry state=pending and emits metric billing.pending.inc
- confirm path: transition pending->posted atomically; emit billing.posted.inc and remove pending metric
- tombstone/overwrite path: transition pending->reversed; emit billing.reversed.inc and tag reversal.reason=tombstone|overwrite|quota
- billing export: only include posted rows. For compatibility, export summary fields (pending_count, reversed_count) until consumers move.

kevin: Rollout UX: default off behind `billing.reversible_credits` flag. Canary to 2% traffic. Dashboard changes: add stacked bars posted/pending/reversed and a table for recent reversals with reason and trace link. Finance will want quick queries for net posted per account.

ops-bot: [alert] token_delta spike 0.09% for delta-inc last 1h — https://console.internal/metrics?m=token_credit&account=delta-inc

maria: Also add a cleanup worker: if pending is left for >2h, auto-post (assume confirm lost) with note auto_post_ttl, but keep reversed path available if later tombstone arrives — in which case issue a reversal and a billing adjustment record.

dan: Need to be careful: retro reversals will be visible in billing exports and might need finance approval. We'll provide a reconciliation report and a flag to suppress auto-post in sensitive accounts.

anya: Telemetry: emit `billing.pending.count`, `billing.posted.count`, `billing.reversed.count`, and `billing.reversal.latency`. Also attach `reversal.cause` tag.

kevin: Tests: unit for state transitions, integration with aggregator/resume race harness, and e2e billing export verification. Migration: add new columns state and reversal_reason; backfill none.

maria: Ill file INF-2026-903 with repro and proposal. Can someone volunteer to implement the ledger state machine?

dan: I can take the PR for the ledger side. kevin can do telemetry and migration. anya can handle dashboard bits.

billing-bot: [ticket] created INF-2026-903 "reversible-credits to handle tombstone races" assigned to dan — https://tickets.internal/INF-2026-903

maria: Thanks all — will add the small harness and sample traces to the ticket. Ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
